summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. (NYSE American: MYND), a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K/materials disclosing that CEO and CFO Arthur Giterman is stepping down effective October 11, 2026, and resigning from the Board the same day. The Board appointed Bin Shen as CEO and Interim CFO effective October 12, 2026, with a permanent CFO search underway. No transaction terms, stake, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The filing notes the intent to regain compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards, making listing-status risk the key watch item alongside execution under new leadership.
